name: switch_skill
description: Switches the active agent's equipped skill (role) mid-work. Use it to activate a different set of competencies and tools for the next phases of the mission (e.g. switching from 'architect' to 'developer').

skill.description: Name of the role/skill to activate (must be one of those unlocked for the active character).

reason.description: Operational rationale for the skill switch.
